'''Coding/Identification Chips''' were custom-programmed chips that were installed in [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Code cylinder/Legends|code cylinders]]. They were encoded with the user's identification and security clearances, including any special accesses that the user had been granted.<ref name="EGWT" />
